input.quote: Contractor shall bill Company as set forth in the relevant Statement of Work. Each invoice submitted by Contractor will provide supporting detail for the Services invoiced, including, to the extent applicable to a particular engagement, the dates of Services and hours worked at the applicable rate by Statement of Work.
input.rationale: The Agreement grants RadialSpark no audit, inspection or verification rights over Clear Capital. The compensation section (§ 3) is a one-way time-and-materials billing mechanic requiring the Contractor to supply supporting detail with its invoices; it confers no right to examine our records, usage or premises. The only access-related provision (§ 1, p0007) runs the other way, obliging the Contractor to comply with our facility and computer-system security policies. Searches for "audit", "inspect", "verif" and "records" return no audit right binding us, so there is no frequency, notice, cost-allocation or system-access exposure to constrain and nothing to redline — this is better than the preferred position (which merely caps such rights at once per 12 months on 30 days' notice at Vendor's cost). If a records-examination right is later added by a Statement of Work, we should apply the preferred limits at that point.
